categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou EZVIZ Network Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: smart home products and IoT cloud platform services. The smart home segment includes intelligent home cameras, smart entry products (such as smart locks and doorbells), intelligent service robots, smart control devices, and smart wearables. The IoT cloud platform segment provides a global visual public cloud platform offering AI and IoT services to consumer users and industry developer clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including AI interaction, visual perception, multi-modal AI understanding, and embodied AI models based on Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture. It has developed the 'EZVIZ Blue Ocean Large Model' for vertical IoT scenarios, enabling edge-cloud collaborative AI capabilities. Production methods include in-house manufacturing with automated and lean supply chain management, supported by dual production bases in Chongqing and Tonglu, China.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EZVIZ serves consumer end-users seeking smart home security, health, and convenience solutions, as well as industry developer clients requiring IoT cloud platform services. Key markets include domestic Chinese consumers and international customers across multiple countries, with products tailored for home security, elderly care, pet care, and commercial cleaning applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with expanding international presence including the United States, Europe, Vietnam, Dubai, and other regions. It maintains over 100 global data centers and local service points to support its IoT cloud platform. Overseas sales channels include cross-border e-commerce, local e-commerce, distributors, and retail chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: EZVIZ operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and cloud service provision. It owns and manages its own manufacturing facilities, ensuring stable delivery and quality control, while also engaging in localized procurement and supplier diversification to mitigate risks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI and IoT dual-core technology development, focusing on embodied AI large models, multi-modal interaction, and intelligent hardware innovation. R&D efforts emphasize smart home cameras, smart entry systems, service robots, and smart wearables, integrating AI cloud services and edge computing. It invests heavily in AI-driven product upgrades, cloud platform enhancements, and ecosystem expansion to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: EZVIZ generates revenue primarily through product sales of smart home devices and IoT hardware. Additionally, it earns subscription and service fees from cloud-based AI and IoT platform services, including value-added consumer services and industry developer platform services. The company also derives income from licensing, advertising, and related service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EZVIZ holds a leading market position in the global smart home camera segment, ranking first in shipment volume worldwide according to IDC. It competes with other smart home and IoT platform providers by leveraging its integrated hardware-software-cloud ecosystem and AI capabilities. Its strong brand recognition and comprehensive product portfolio differentiate it in a competitive landscape.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, EZVIZ achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.44 billion, representing a 12.41% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 503.9 million, a 10.52% decrease compared to the previous year, reflecting increased investment in new product market development. The company has total assets of RMB 8.35 billion and net assets of RMB 5.49 billion, with steady growth in both domestic and international markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EZVIZ emphasizes its unique value through advanced AI-driven visual perception and embodied intelligence technologies, enabling smart home devices with enhanced interaction, scene awareness, and personalized services. Its '2+5+N' product ecosystem integrates AI and IoT cloud capabilities to deliver differentiated solutions across security, entry, cleaning, health, and companionship scenarios. The company also focuses on high-quality manufacturing, comprehensive cloud services, and a robust global platform to provide reliable, intelligent, and user-friendly smart home experiences.
